与友谊与社交一起成长(Growing up with friendship): 一篇关于社交生活的B1记叙文:格蕾丝的经历、感受与成长。
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Grace thanked Jack for the honest advice. Little by little, things began to change. Authoritative parents set rules and explain them.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. People around Grace often share different ideas about the birthday party. The class meeting has become an important part of daily life. What's more, volunteering doubles as networking.

Grace keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The birthday party looked quieter than usual that evening. For example, the old truck shook violently whenever it went over a bump.
The experience taught Grace more than any book could. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The lazy student never finishes homework.
Grace has practiced football for three years and won a prize last term. Grace usually spends the weekend reading at the bookstore. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
